bibliography.title: DTO-KD: Dynamic Trade-off Optimization for Effective Knowledge Distillation

sections.title: 3.1 KD as a Dynamic Trade-off Optimization

abstract_sentences.text: Knowledge Distillation (KD) is a widely adopted framework for compressing large models into compact student models by transferring knowledge from a high-capacity teacher.

evidence.anchor: compressing large models into compact student models

abstract_sentences.text: Despite its success, KD presents two persistent challenges: (1) the trade-off between optimizing for the primary task loss and mimicking the teacher’s outputs, and (2) the gradient disparity arising from architectural and representational mismatches between teacher and student models.

In this work, we propose Dynamic Trade-off Optimization for Knowledge Distillation (DTO-KD), a principled multi-objective optimization formulation of KD that dynamically balances task and distillation losses at the gradient level.

evidence.anchor: dynamically balances task and distillation losses at the gradient level

abstract_sentences.text: Specifically, DTO-KD resolves two critical issues in gradient-based KD optimization: (i) gradient conflict, where task and distillation gradients are directionally misaligned, and (ii) gradient dominance, where one objective suppresses learning progress on the other.
Our method adapts per-iteration trade-offs by leveraging gradient projection techniques to ensure balanced and constructive updates.
We evaluate DTO-KD on large-scale benchmarks including ImageNet-1K for classification and COCO for object detection.

evidence.anchor: ImageNet-1K for classification and COCO for object detection

abstract_sentences.text: Across both tasks, DTO-KD outperforms prior KD methods, yielding state-of-the-art accuracy and improved convergence behavior.
Furthermore, student trained with DTO-KD exceed the performance of their non-distilled counterparts, demonstrating the efficacy of our multi-objective formulation.

evidence.anchor: exceed the performance of their non-distilled counterparts

final_judgment.single_storyline: 单一主线是把 KD 的任务损失与蒸馏损失从固定加权改写为每步梯度级二目标最小范数/动态权重更新，以缓解 GrC 与 GrD；Figure 1 是诊断，式 (9)–(15) 是机制，Tables 1–5 是任务证据。[p.2、p.4–9，§1、§3–§4]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留问题定义、GrC/GrD、Pareto/MOO 转换、闭式权重、Algorithm 1、amortized 近似、ImageNet/CIFAR/COCO 点结果、组件消融和 teacher-scale 对照。[p.4–10，§3–§6]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 没有实际 appendix/supplementary；§3 预告分类/检测具体 loss 将在 appendix 定义，但 p.10 后直接进入 p.11 References，因此这些细节在当前文件不可见。[p.4、p.10–13]
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 将网络、projector、loss head 与 MOO 流程可视化，Algorithm 1 把它转为步骤，Table 1–3 给主结果，Table 4 再给组件增量，形成机制→主结果→消融。[p.4、p.7–9]
final_judgment.largest_gap: 理论把 simplex 闭式解、alignment、norm bounds 与 Pareto convergence 用近似普遍语气陈述，但无 domain conditions、proof 或 amortized guarantee；实验又无 seed、误差、完整 loss 定义和 compute profiling。[p.5–10，§3.1、§4–§6]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 动态多目标优化论文必须同时给出权重可行域的边界处理、退化梯度条件、精确/近似算法差异，并为每个理论预测配独立且可重复的机制证据。[p.5–7，§3.1]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于共享参数且目标梯度可比较的多目标训练；本文证据仅覆盖 available-data 的视觉 KD、ImageNet/CIFAR/COCO 与 ViDT/DeiT/RegNetY，不能外推到 data-free、其他模态或部署成本。[p.7–10，§4–§6]
